lists.content:
Prefr (operated by CreditVidya) is a digital-first lending platform that makes credit accessible to millions across India. with loan offerings ranging from ₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakh, we’re enabling instant personal loans and flexible pay-later credit lines, especially for first-time borrowers and underserved regions. backed by RBI-approved NBFC partnerships, we’ve built a platform that uses selfie-based KYC, minimal documentation, and AI-powered underwriting to disburse loans within minutes.

we are seeking an experienced Finance Manager to oversee the accounting, payments, and treasury functions for a fast-growing Fintech company and will lead the AP team, ensuring timely and accurate payments of company liabilities, optimizing the AP process, and working closely with vendors, procurement, and internal stakeholders. the Finance Manager will ensure compliance with statutory requirements (TDS, GST, MSME Act, Companies Act) and optimize cash flow management while driving financial process improvements and ensuring the accuracy of financial statements.

What will you do?

  • oversee daily accounting operations, including managing the general ledger, journal entries, reconciliations, and month-end closing

  • ensure timely and accurate processing of payments (vendor payments, taxes) and adherence to internal control standards

  • establish and maintain strong relationships with vendors, ensuring effective dispute resolution and favorable terms

  • manage treasury functions, including cash flow management, forecasting, and working capital optimization

  • ensure compliance with statutory regulations, including TDS, GST, MSME Act, and Companies Act, and coordinate with auditors during internal and external audits

  • develop and implement financial policies, procedures, and internal controls to safeguard company assets

  • prepare and publish AP-related reports (e.g., cash flow forecasting, aging analysis)

  • collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., product team, sales team, collection team, Admin team) to ensure financial alignment with business operations

  • prepare, analyze, and present financial reports to senior management, including cash flow projections and variance analysis

  • lead initiatives to improve financial systems and processes, leveraging automation tools. Optimize the AP workflow through automation, process improvements, and implementation of best practices

  • monitor and manage banking relationships

  • manage vendor onboarding and master vendor data maintenance, ensuring data accuracy

  • manage and mentor a team of AP specialists, providing training and performance feedback

    •  

    You should apply if you are/have:

  • Chartered Accountant with 4-7 years of experience

  • deep understanding of Indian statutory regulations (TDS, GST, MSME Act, Companies Act)

  • proven track record of process improvement and automation in AP

  • strong knowledge of treasury management, cash flow forecasting, and working capital optimization

  • experience in financial reporting, reconciliations, and managing audits

  • good communication and interpersonal skills to articulate and collaborate across departments

descriptionPlain:
what is CRED?
 
CRED is an exclusive community for india’s most trustworthy and creditworthy individuals, where the members are rewarded for good financial behavior. 
 
CRED was born out of a need to bring back the focus on a long lost virtue, one of trust, the idea being to create a community centered around this virtue. a community that constantly strives to become more virtuous in this regard till they finally scale their behavior to create a utopia where being trustworthy is the norm and not the exception. to build a community like this requires a community of its own; a community special in its own way, working towards making this vision come true. 
 
here’s a thought experiment: what do you get when you put a group of incredibly passionate and driven people and entrust them with the complete freedom to chase down their goals in a completely uninhibited manner? answer: you get something close to what we have at CRED; CRED just has it better. 
 
You’ll play a pivotal role in leading CRED's partner ecosystem across products, becoming the face of CRED to some of India’s top consumer brands. You will lead high-stakes partnerships, drive product adoption, and enable new growth through strategic merchant alliances. As a core part of the merchant-led growth (mlg) strategy, you’ll shape how millions engage with CRED.

description:
VA Tech (a CRED company, formerly Happay) is CRED's B2B payments infrastructure business.
 

Role Purpose:

Own and scale VA Tech's commercial engine – pipeline, enterprise sales, and partnerships — across banks, fintechs, and enterprise ecosystem partners, converting VA Tech's platform capability into predictable, compounding revenue.

lists.content:
business development

  • own pipeline generation across banks, fintechs, and enterprise ecosystem partners.
  • build and qualify a diversified pipeline aligned to VA Tech's priority segments.
  • convert market opportunity into signed, revenue-generating partnerships.

    • enterprise sales

  • lead complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles end-to-end.
  • own commercial proposals, structuring, and negotiation within an agreed mandate.
  • drive forecasting accuracy and pipeline governance.

    • strategic partnerships

  • build and institutionalize partnerships across banks, fintechs, payment networks, ERP platforms, and technology partners.
  • structure partnership models that convert into durable, multi-year commercial relationships.
  • own partnership health and expansion for the full portfolio outside top-tier strategic accounts.

    • commercial excellence

  • institutionalize commercial playbooks, pricing frameworks, and deal-desk discipline.
  • build repeatable processes for proposal generation, negotiation, and closure.
  • drive consistency in commercial terms across the partner portfolio.

    • go-to-market

  • execute VA Tech's go-to-market strategy across defined segments and geographies.
  • translate platform capability into segment-specific commercial narratives.
  • partner with Marketing and Product to sharpen market positioning.

    • market intelligence

  • track competitive movement, pricing, and partnership models across the payments infrastructure landscape.
  • convert field intelligence into structured input for Product and the Business Head.
  • Identify early signals of opportunity or risk in the banking and payments ecosystem.

    • cross-functional leadership

  • influence Product, Technology, Operations, Finance, Compliance, and Legal to unblock commercial outcomes.
  • represent commercial priorities in cross-functional planning without owning those functions.
  • build working relationships that move deals through internal approval cycles quickly.

    • sales governance

  • own pipeline reviews, forecasting cadence, and deal-stage discipline.
  • build a single source of truth for commercial performance.
  • flag risk early — no surprises in forecast-to-close conversion.

    • commercial operations

  • own commercial reporting, contract lifecycle coordination, and deal documentation discipline.
  • build the operating rhythm — reviews, reporting, escalation paths — that lets the function scale.
  • coordinate with Finance and Legal on commercial terms and contract structuring.

    • team development

  • build and lead a commercial pod as volume justifies headcount.
  • institutionalize onboarding, coaching, and performance management for the team.
  • build a bench for future scale — this function should not be a single point of failure.

• have 7-12yrs of experience in Business Development, Enterprise Sales, or Strategic Partnerships within payments, fintech, or banking infrastructure.
  • demonstrated ownership of a commercial pipeline — origination through closure — not just relationship management.
  • proven track record structuring and closing partnerships with banks, NBFCs, or payment networks.
  • strong command of commercial and contractual structuring — pricing, terms, negotiation.
  • executive presence — credible in front of CXOs at banks and large enterprises.

description:
help shape CRED’s d2c ecosystem by partnering with India’s most exciting consumer brands and turning those relationships into meaningful member value and business growth.

you’ll work at the intersection of d2c, consumer growth, payments, rewards and product - bringing relevant brands and differentiated constructs to CRED members, while helping d2c businesses acquire customers, drive growth and build deeper engagement.

this is a role for someone who can spot opportunities, build relationships, sell, and turn ideas into high-impact partnerships.

lists.content:
• build and own the d2c pipeline - identify the right brands, founders and opportunities, and drive partnerships from first conversation to revenue realisation.

  • carry a revenue quota and relentlessly deliver against it through new business, monetisation and partner growth.

  • build deep relationships with d2c founders, cxos, growth leaders and the vc ecosystem backing the category.

  • create differentiated partnerships that drive brand growth, customer acquisition, retention and engagement.

  • bring the best d2c brands and propositions to CRED members through rewards, offers, experiences and privileges.

  • drive adoption of CRED payment instruments across high-quality d2c brands.

  • look beyond standard partnerships - identify strategic, product, payment, data and growth-led opportunities that can create outsized value for both CRED and the brand.

  • work cross-functionally with product, growth, marketing, analytics and operations to turn ideas into live, scaled partnerships.

  • own execution end-to-end - zero hand-holding, high velocity, and a strong bias for getting things done.

This is not a relationship-management role. It is a builder + seller role for someone who wants to shape CRED’s d2c ecosystem.

  • 4+ years in quota-carrying sales, business development, partnerships or key account roles within d2c, consumer internet, ecommerce, fintech or high-growth startups.

  • strong existing network across d2c founders, cxos, growth/marketing leaders and consumer brands.

  • deep understanding of the Indian d2c ecosystem and curiosity about emerging brands, categories and trends.

  • proven track record of closing deals and delivering commercial outcomes.

  • strong commercial and strategic thinking - able to look at a brand and quickly identify “what could we build together?”

  • high-energy, extremely driven and razor-sharp on execution.

  • excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to sell to founders and senior leadership.

  • comfortable operating in ambiguity, building from scratch and owning outcomes end-to-end.

additionalPlain:
how is life at CRED?
working at CRED would instantly make you realize one thing: you are working with the best talent around you. not just in the role you occupy, but everywhere you go. talk to someone around you; most likely you will be talking to a singer, standup comic, artist, writer, an athlete, maybe a magician. at CRED people always have talent up their sleeves. with the right company, even conversations can be rejuvenating. at CRED, we guarantee a good company.
hard truths: pushing oneself comes with the role. and we realise pushing oneself is hard work. which is why CRED is in the continuous process of building an environment that helps the team rejuvenate oneself: included but not limited to a stacked, in-house pantry, with lunch and dinner provided for all the team members, paid sick leaves and a comprehensive health insurance. 
to make things smoother and to make sure you spend time and energy only on the most important things,  CRED strives to make every process transparent: there are no work timings because we do not believe in archaic methods of calculating productivity, your work should speak for you. there are no job designations because you will be expected to hold down roles that cannot be described in one word. since trust is a major virtue in the community we have built, we make it a point to highlight it in the community behind CRED: all our team members get their salaries before their joining date. a show of trust that speaks volumes because of the skin in the game.  
there are many more such eccentricities that make CRED what it is but that’s for one to discover. if you feel at home reading this, get in touch.

CRED is an exclusive community for India's most trustworthy and creditworthy individuals, where the members are rewarded for good financial behavior. CRED was born out of a need to bring back the focus on a long lost virtue, one of trust, the idea being to create a community centered around this virtue. a community that constantly strives to become more virtuous in this regard till they finally scale their behavior to create a utopia where being trustworthy is the norm and not the exception. here's a thought experiment: what do you get when you put a group of incredibly passionate and driven people and entrust them with the complete freedom to chase down their goals in a completely uninhibited manner? answer: you get something close to what we have at CRED; CRED just has it better.

here's what will be in store for you at CRED once you join the team.

as part of the credit card bill payments (ccbp) team at CRED, you'll be responsible for the overall growth of credit-card bill payments on the platform - the flow through which members pay their credit card bills (their own and others') via CRED. ccbp is one of the highest-frequency, highest-trust actions on the app, and directly compounds into CRED's growth and retention.

lists.content:
• own key input levers of the ccbp business - acquisition and resurrection of members paying credit card bills, and multi-card adoption - deep-diving on metrics and diagnosing drop-offs to course-correct performance.
  • track and report on these levers daily/weekly/monthly, owning monthly planning and flagging deviations early.
  • exercise judgment on when to resolve issues independently vs. escalate, and anticipate recurring problem patterns before they hit the numbers.
  • own execution across the bill-pay funnel (discovery, reminders, payment, retry/failure), building preventive and reactive interventions to lift conversion.
  • translate broader category strategy into concrete campaigns, experiments, and milestones you can ship and measure.
  • own merchandising for ccbp on and off app - home page assets, cross-sell placements, communication plans.
  • design and run campaigns (offers, cashback, reward mechanics) to drive adoption and repeat usage, optimizing spend for roI rather than just reach.
  • focus on reducing friction and building payment confidence — low-cost engagement over short-term yield maximization.
  • run a constant experimentation cadence (A/B/multivariate testing) to find growth inflection points, and productize what works into the core journey.
  • partner with product and data science teams to build personalization models (due-date prediction, smart nudges, next-best-card-to-pay) that increase throughput.
  • bring clear, data-backed narratives to cross-functional discussions (Marketing, Rewards, Product, Risk) to align on priorities and unblock execution.

• 4–7 years of experience in user growth/ category management roles, with prior ownership of high-frequency consumer transaction/payment categories or 3-5 years of experience in management consulting, investment banking, growth strategy, corporate strategy, or fintech strategy roles.
  • data-driven mindset — comfortable analyzing data to form hypotheses, identify opportunities, and measure experiment success.
  • track record of driving growth initiatives end-to-end (ideation → execution → measurable impact) at a consumer-first company.
  • high ownership and bias for action in a fast-paced, ambiguous, agile environment.
  • strong program/project management skills - able to run multiple cross-functional initiatives (product, marketing, risk, ops) simultaneously with attention to detail.

to make things smoother and to make sure you spend time and energy only on the most important things,  CRED strives to make every process transparent: there are no work timings because we do not believe in archaic methods of calculating productivity, your work should speak for you. there are no job designations because you will be expected to hold down roles that cannot be described in one word. since trust is a major virtue in the community we have built, we make it a point to highlight it in the community behind CRED: all our employees get their salaries before their joining date. a show of trust that speaks volumes because of the skin in the game. 
 
there are many more such eccentricities that make CRED what it is but that’s for one to discover. if you feel at home reading this, get in touch.

lists.content:
category ownership & p&l

  • own the category end-to-end, including growth strategy, economics, forecasting, and reporting
  • drive planning cadences, operating reviews, and performance tracking for the category
  • balance growth, reliability, cost-to-serve, and long-term sustainability
  • make clear trade-offs between engagement, scale, and economics

    • strategy & roadmap definition

  • partner with product and design teams to define the long-term vision and roadmap
  • identify levers to drive 2–3× growth in active transacting members
  • reimagine user journeys, frequency drivers, and habit loops within the category
  • translate category strategy into executable priorities and milestones

    • growth & engagement

  • drive adoption and repeat usage 
  • design strategies to reduce friction, increase trust, and improve payment confidence
  • focus on low-cost engagement, not yield maximisation
  • use data and experimentation to identify and unlock growth inflection points

    • ecosystem & regulatory collaboration

  • work closely with relevant networks, regulators, and internal compliance teams to ensure regulatory alignment
  • anticipate ecosystem or policy changes and factor them into category strategy
  • represent category requirements clearly in cross-functional and partner discussions

    • cross-functional leadership

  • act as the single-threaded owner working across product, engineering, compliance, finance, and growth
  • influence without authority through clear problem framing, structured thinking, and data-backed narratives
  • drive clarity in ambiguous spaces and align teams around common outcomes

• 6–10 years of experience in payments or fintech, with prior ownership of high-frequency consumer payment categories in India
  • direct experience working across regulated payment rails and partner ecosystems
  • proven track record of scaling high-frequency consumer payment categories
  • strong strategic and analytical skills — able to translate insight into execution
  • experience owning P&L, planning, and business performance cadences
  • ability to operate cross-functionally in regulated environments
  • high ownership mindset with strong collaboration ethos

description:
what is CRED?
 
CRED is an exclusive community for india’s most trustworthy and creditworthy individuals, where the members are rewarded for good financial behavior. 
 
CRED was born out of a need to bring back the focus on a long lost virtue, one of trust, the idea being to create a community centered around this virtue. a community that constantly strives to become more virtuous in this regard till they finally scale their behavior to create a utopia where being trustworthy is the norm and not the exception. to build a community like this requires a community of its own; a community special in its own way, working towards making this vision come true. 
 
here’s a thought experiment: what do you get when you put a group of incredibly passionate and driven people and entrust them with the complete freedom to chase down their goals in a completely uninhibited manner? answer: you get something close to what we have at CRED; CRED just has it better.

lists.content:
• build trust in and understanding of CRED among external audiences by producing a steady body of editorial: blogs, website content, reports, and brand and product narratives that shape how people think about money, credit, and the category CRED operates in.

  • think like a fintech and lifestyle journalist. mine product, engineering, design, and talent teams for the details worth telling, then connect them into stories that are new, credible, and grounded in the CRED brand and its values.

  • own the writing end to end: point of view, structure, and line-level craft, plus the judgment to match each story to the right format (long-form report, blog, product page, founder essay, social).

  • hold the editorial bar for the brand across voice, rigour, and factual defensibility, so everything published under CRED reads like it came from one credible mind.

lists.text: you should apply if you have:
lists.content:
• a track record of owning and shaping narratives over the long term, not just filling a content calendar

  • a body of work that proves range across formats and a distinct point of view 

  • the ability to work across teams with different priorities and still land a coherent story

  • Deeply passionate about tech and has worked on long form tech content writing

  • background in fintech, business, or lifestyle editorial

  • experience writing in a founder or executive voice

  • ability to predict, measure, and articulate the impact of editorial against CRED's business and comms priorities

  • data sensibility for reports and long-form
